scope: Read-only source/interface/dependency audit; no source modification, EDA or hardware execution.

snapshot_module.reset: Asynchronous active-low rst_n clears both valid flags/tuples, follow counter, uptime and wrap flag.
snapshot_module.trigger: At a ref_clk edge, if no prior first_valid and pipeline_released && (!qualified || input_failed || !ready_all), atomically capture live_tuple and set first_valid.
snapshot_module.follow: Capture a second live_tuple exactly FOLLOWUP_REF_CYCLES subsequent reference edges after first capture; default 54000/27MHz=2ms. First/follow then remain immutable until rst_n resets the epoch.
snapshot_module.clock_contract: All scalar inputs and the whole 256-bit live_tuple must already be stable/coherent in ref_clk. This module does not synchronize a multi-bit pixel/core-domain bus or implement a source-domain request/ack handshake.
snapshot_module.uptime: ref_uptime increments once per ref_clk; snapshot on that same edge observes the prior register value. uptime_wrapped becomes sticky after wrap.
snapshot_module.feedback: Only snapshot and debug outputs; no reset, admission, DDR, DMA, scan-enable or bank-ownership output.

uart_module.dependency: uart_tx, with parameters CLOCK_HZ and BAUD, ports clk/rst_n/start/data[7:0]/tx/busy/done. The exact first-party source exists in O/P; no vendor DDR/IP is needed for this standalone three-module closure.
uart_module.reset: No external reset input. Two initialized release_pipe bits create a local startup release. Manual global system reset clears snapshot but does not restart UART packet_count or the 240-packet budget. Treat UART lifetime as configuration/power-up lifetime unless a separately reviewed reset extension is added.
uart_module.clock_contract: The valid flags and all three tuple buses are sampled in clk_27m; use the same 27MHz reference domain as snapshot, or add an explicit coherent CDC mechanism outside this unit.
uart_module.atomicity: At packet start, copy both selected tuples and header flags into held_payload[639:0], then serialize that held payload; input changes during the packet do not tear it.
uart_module.cadence: Nominal idle gap 0.25s plus packet transmit duration; 240 packets produce about 62s, then stop until new configuration/power-up.
uart_module.serial: uart_tx sends 8N1 LSB-first. BIT_CYCLES=(CLOCK_HZ+BAUD/2)/BAUD=234 at defaults, giving about 115384.6 baud.

fields.field: bit0 first_valid, bit1 follow_valid, bit2 uptime_wrapped; bits3..7 zero
first_tuple if first_valid else live_tuple sampled at packet start
follow_tuple if follow_valid else live_tuple sampled at packet start
CRC32 over bytes0..79, reflected polynomial EDB88320, initial FFFFFFFF, final invert; zlib.crc32-compatible

measurement_limits: No image-correctness or optical end-to-end latency proof

published_top_adapter.selected_status: In report-only mode use functional_input_qualified/functional_input_failed for first-loss trigger; strict status remains in diagnostic flags/reasons.
published_top_adapter.ready_all: observer_reset_n && !observer_epoch_reset && cfg_lock_ref[1] && video_lock_ref[1] && rx_done_ref[1] && tx_done_ref[1] && ddr_ready_ref[1] && !board_failed
published_top_adapter.tuple_width_check: Direct targeted source read confirms L194 runtime_live_flags is [31:0] and L195 runtime_live_tuple is the intended 8-word 256-bit packing. No width/truncation defect is asserted.
published_top_adapter.uart_selection: Compile-time generate: INPUT_RUNTIME_DIAG_ONLY selects PGIQ0001 runtime UART; otherwise STARTUP_DIAG_ONLY selects startup UART; otherwise normal_telemetry_tx. These are mutually exclusive whole-port selections, not a byte-level mux.
published_top_adapter.feedback_boundary: The patch adds passive reason outputs to dvp_mode_admission_monitor and hdmi1080_input_status and observes existing signals. Those two modified monitor files must be evaluated for named-port compatibility when used with peer code; do not replace an identically named peer implementation blindly.

required_tuple_ref_words: status flags matching host decoder names
upstream_signals_needed.clock_alignment: PLL/RX/TX/DDR-ready/system-failed flags in published top are two-stage synchronized into clk_27m before tuple construction (top L85..100). Pixel-domain geometry/fault observations arrive via existing input-status monitor snapshots, not direct async buses.
upstream_signals_needed.first_loss_scope: The trigger is qualification/failed/ready loss after pipeline_release. A pure strict timing warning in report-only mode does not necessarily trigger; it is present in the live diagnostic words.

covered: input-status control miter for healthy geometry, bad geometry, stopped rate and stopped-clock reset
not_established: complete top/system functional or formal equivalence
prior_validation.physical_status_from_published_readme: Original standalone physical experiment 6 setup violations/WNS -0.030ns; separate same-source 50ps hold-fix experiment 4 violations/WNS -0.032ns. Different physical DB identities; no timing pass.

this_audit.scope: CPU synthetic-packet / published host decoder only; no HDL, EDA, serial or board calls
